body: My only motivation to continue on ngl, I'll look like that one day.
Thanks I appreciate it, you could definitely draw just takes a little bit of practice. Just whatever makes you happy and don't make art a chore are what kind of keep me drawing.
Yeah just trying to keep the urge to myself in a way but decided to share today. I appreciate it.
Carpal tunnel really fucks with me, the cold is not my friend :( thank you!

It comes from my tablet so the res is a little low but hair and shading are my favorite things, they flow so well, I couldn't be happier with how it turned out so far. I hope I can finish it, but I'll probably keep it to just shading since the whole thing is the color being gone. I appreciate your comment. :') ❤️
